verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents search that matches filenames, symbols, line numbers and text content, with fuzzy matching for filenames and symbols. It also supports regular expressions wrapped in slashes, but only within the file scope. Filters are only implied by the mention of a 'file scope', and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit filter documentation, regex beyond the single-file scope, fuzzy matching for text content, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and navigate code content using fuzzy matching, filters, and regular expressions

citations.quote: Search queries will be matched against filenames, symbols, line numbers and text content. For filenames and symbols a fuzzy matching will be performed
Regular expression search is supported for the file scope by wrapping your pattern in slashes such as /[0-9]+/ to find all integers.
